mechanism: Primidone induces hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing mefloquine plasma concentrations and efficacy, while mefloquine may lower primidone seizure threshold and increase CNS toxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if co-administration is necessary, monitor mefloquine antimalarial efficacy closely and consider alternative anticonvulsant or antimalarial agents.
